purpose: Coupled passenger platform waiting, timed destination/question requests, exact cached-pixel approach, land/water boarding, carried fare countdown and delivery with real native item allocation and deferred completion.

inputs: PassengerStoneSlot and immutable current/paired ActorType, separate persistent ActorRenderHistory, borrowed ten-platform geometry and two craft records.
Player count, water line, score, multiplier/cap and HUD low byte. Incoming boarding/delivery craft is separate from the stored carrier.
outputs: Ordered semantic field/index/value journal, immediate-tail request and selected craft; typed item launch and bonus sound requests.
Bonus delivery publishes score then returns a pending continuation. Only successful item allocation AND audio permit passenger_delivery_finish to update Y, cursor, countdown and HUD.

BOARD/DELIVER tails consume the full native selected craft after the parent journal and before the callee. Normal return rejects an unconsumed non-NONE next request or finish_pending. ACTOR_VERIFY checks active native working state at each matching cut.
effects: Initializers seed phase, cursor FFFE, countdown 1 and phase-specific overlay/pose/request. Updating land handlers may move, display, board, or pair to water and call L1 BeginPassengerResurfacing.

Boarding publishes fare/floor, phase, carried kind, destination icon, carrier alias, hidden sprite, quick countdown 200, then frees source occupancy. Rescue reads both fares from the water descriptor before switching to its land pair.

Carried step unsigned-decrements fare above floor, signed-positive-decrements quick countdown, then may deliver immediately. Delivery clears the incoming craft, uses the stored carrier for position/fare, adds wrapping 32-bit fare*multiplier to score, and may request an item/audio before finishing.
preconditions: Ordinary disjoint accessible RAM, stack and immutable finite descriptors/animation banks. Physical actor slot below sixteen; native fields are ordinary indices, not doubled offsets.

Bridge admits DS=DGROUP, CS=GAME, even actor index below32, one of the six exact passenger descriptors and checked pair/callback identities. Land-only handlers reject water; rescue requires water; the three request/approach initializers admit both.

PlayerCount is one or two and PlayerArrayBytes is twice that value. Incoming craft is valid for boarding/rescue/delivery; active stored carrier is checked by the existing alias projection. Malformed state retains explicit L1 compatibility before native publication.

Live source is below ten with its paired doubled index for waiting/request/approach/boarding/rescue. Live destination is below ten and paired for approach/boarding/rescue/carried/delivery. Initializer destination words remain arbitrary, including wrapped icon arithmetic.

Four immutable nonempty live animation vectors terminate with FFFF inside the registered bank [Animation_0E20,1020h), at most255 live words plus the terminal. Due animation cursors and approach current cursors must address an available live/sentinel word; malformed vectors/cursors retain L1.

Native caller consumes each output once, applies internal tail after the journal, routes contact/audio through existing entries and bonus allocation through the actual native items bridge. Full-pool abnormal transfer does not run the continuation.

The fixed multiplier item resource retains its registered spawn/update/landing/expiry callback identities. Its other scalar fields remain arbitrary in B; arbitrary callback corruption of that service descriptor is outside this native proof.

callers: DispatchActorUpdates iterates physical active slots in order; accepted itinerary placement initializes platform wait through the existing exported entry.
Land and floating request handlers call the shared initializers; floating approach calls the water-boarding entry. Water dynamics remain L1 unit six. No register/flag liveness elimination is assumed.

indirect.classification: Descriptor identities checked before execution; every immediate target and complete consumed journal checked at transfer. Native result requests the target; retained machine shell preserves full registers/flags/stack and original service return sites.

owned: Actor phase, current type pair, active pose/request/carrier alias, current sprite/overlay, X/Y, animation cursor/countdown and quick-delivery word.
Craft fare/floor/kind/icon, source platform occupancy clear, score words and HUD low byte.
borrowed: Current cached pixel X/Y and all renderer history survive; craft positions/platforms/pixel X and immutable platform geometry/icons.
Current/paired descriptor geometry, period, fare/floor/kind and animation resources. Item allocation/benefits and audio retain their existing owners.
memory.aliases: Existing per-phase table unchanged. Wait reads waiting_pose only; destination/question read request_ticks only; carried/delivery read carrier only. Approach reads none. Delivery snapshots the valid carrier before changing phase to walk; finish reads no inactive alias. ACTOR_VERIFY poisons inactive aliases. Journal alias tags are checked against the published phase. Full size_t carrier and ordinary journal indices are range checked before inverse projection; no high-bit truncation is accepted. The phase alias table is unchanged.
memory.renderer: No renderer histories or pixel caches are recomputed, cleared or serialized; previous coordinates, erase sprites and cached pixels remain untouched.
memory.representation: Only bridge code knows original addresses, doubled identities, callback targets, stack/register/flag effects. Ordinary native code contains typed phases, resources, craft indices, arithmetic and effects.

assumptions: One-step B composition on actual maintained C, from any admitted state. No initialization reachability, scalar magnitude, cleared renderer history, free item slot or positive timer/fare restriction.

Ordinary disjoint RAM/resources/stack; one or two crafts, ten platforms. Fixed selected slot0 is justified by uniform constant-offset addressing; arbitrary-other-slot byte frame checks every other physical identity. Finite tests additionally vary all sixteen physical slots.

Animation primitive admits every registered nonempty bank fitting [0E20,1020), any current live/terminal cursor, arbitrary live values and all four vector kinds. Caller tick/frame seams have arbitrary shared poststates and assert input/vector equality. Resource/cursor corruption outside bridge admission keeps L1 compatibility.

Contact query composes with contacts certificate kind0 whole-bridge B, including arbitrary geometry. Item request composes with falling_items spawn B, including all twelve occupied slots and its abnormal transfer. Audio uses the existing entry and a shared arbitrary status/register result at the caller proof seam; child footprints remain owned by their certificates.

Output, byte frame and input dependence are distinct profiles. Literal source partition, native orchestration and journal-prefix lemmas compose the stages; all protocol/service controls and complete machine registers/flags/ordered stores are outputs. The actual complete projection predicate is proved separately and checked at matching production cuts.
L0-to-L1 evidence remains independently rebuilt C/D. None of this is evidence for matching DOS bytes.
eliminated: Native API has no machine registers, addresses, dispatch or flag model. An ordered typed journal retains every observable passenger/global store and the bridge validates its values/order.
Source/destination/carrier doubled byte indices are inverse-projected only under checked paired-index admission; malformed states keep L1.
retained: 140-call request countdown; predecrement zero wraps to FFFF. Animation countdown/period zero wraps; frame terminal resets only on FFFF.
Wait skips busy craft to find an empty platform match; destination rejects its first busy match even when a later craft is empty; approach selects first platform match regardless of kind.
Approach equality uses stale cached pixel X plus anchor minus16 exactly, even between ticks; unequal cases animate between ticks and move only when due. No snap/overshoot tolerance.
Submersion uses the sign of the wrapped half-height+cachedY-water subtraction. First touching airborne craft triggers water pairing; water dynamics stay L1.
Fare floor comparison is unsigned across 8000. Quick countdown decrements only when signed-positive, but delivery bonus tests any nonzero quick word, including negative stale values.
Rescue publishes water fare/floor before pairing, then uses land carried kind. Delivery clears incoming DI craft but positions/scores using stored carrier, even if they differ.

Score is wrapping uint32 fare*multiplier addition. Bonus compares full unsigned multiplier/cap; actual native allocator scans twelve slots in reverse and retains negative-sprite allocation and full-pool pending transfer quirks.
Full pool preserves post-service Y/animation/HUD and performs no audio. HUD writes only its low byte after normal completion; all stale adjacent bytes/histories survive.
